results.title: Recent checks
results.empty: No tasks yet. Submit a link above to run the first check.

docs.title: XSpeed documentation
docs.intro: XSpeed is a service that monitors VLESS connection speeds. A probe runs on a node, receives tasks over WebSocket, performs a speedtest through xray, and returns the result to the server.

createTask.title: POST /api/v1/tasks
createTask.description: Create a new task. Body: { link, probe_tokens? }.

getTask.title: GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}
getTask.description: Fetch a task with its results.

listRegions.title: GET /api/v1/regions
listRegions.description: List regions with probe_count and last_median_mbps aggregates.

onlineProbes.title: GET /api/v1/probes/online
onlineProbes.description: Per-region summary: online probes and median speed.

docs.wsDescription: Probes connect to /ws with a token in the Authorization: Bearer header. After the online message the server dispatches tasks; the probe returns a result.

events.taskAssigned: task.assigned → probe is given a task
events.online: online → probe reports alias, region and version
events.result: result → probe returns a speed value or error
